channel.title: Comments on: Prayer songs for difficult times.

item.title: By: eimearrekindlingspirit
item.dc:creator: eimearrekindlingspirit
item.content:encoded:
In reply to Mikie Feighan.

The Irish language can hold that grief, that pain.

It knows it well.

Bringing it to healing waters in Ireland

Sounds like an act of radical

Tenderness

item.title: By: Mikie Feighan
item.dc:creator: Mikie Feighan
item.content:encoded:
would it be okay for you to add the lyrics in the language in which they are being sung?  My skin longs to join in this singing, lamenting prayer and to bring it to a sacred well in Ireland, with respect and reverence and a broken heart.
